changelog:
Initial release of meeting-quality-scorer:

- Objectively scores meeting transcripts across three key dimensions: decision clarity, time efficiency, and participation balance.
- Generates both a Markdown report and an interactive HTML visualization.
- Works with any OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (Ollama, DeepSeek, OpenAI, etc.).
- Integrates smoothly with meeting_whisper for a transcribe-then-score workflow.
- Fully configurable via environment variables or YAML config file.
- Ensures privacy: no telemetry, transcript sent only to your specified LLM backend.
